channel.title: UK Defence Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: Thales to build AI mine warfare hubs for Royal Navy
item.description: Thales has been awarded an initial £10 million contract to deliver AI-enabled remote command centres for Royal Navy mine countermeasures. The post Thales to build AI mine warfare hubs for Royal Navy first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: First Jackal 3 Extenda vehicles completed in Devonport
item.description: Babcock says the first Jackal 3 Extenda vehicles from the second production tranche have rolled off the Devonport line, marking a key milestone in the programme to deliver new high-mobility platforms to the British Army. The post First Jackal 3 Extenda vehicles completed in Devonport first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: First Jupiter HC2 enters UK service ahead of deployment
item.description: The first Jupiter HC2 helicopter has begun flying operations at RAF Benson, marking its entry into UK service and the start of a programme that will replace ageing Bell 212 and 412 aircraft in Brunei and Cyprus from early 2026. The post First Jupiter HC2 enters UK service ahead of deployment first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Sweden and Finland place $171m order for BAE 3P rounds
item.description: BAE Systems has secured contracts worth around 171 million dollars to supply its Bofors 40mm and 57mm 3P programmable ammunition to Sweden and Finland. The post Sweden and Finland place $171m order for BAE 3P rounds first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: BAE Systems to integrate new IFF on South Korea’s KF-21
item.description: BAE Systems has secured an $11 million contract from Korea Aerospace Industries to integrate the AN/APX-127(V)1 Combined Interrogator Transponder on the KF-21 Boramae fighter, replacing the APX-126(V) currently fitted to the platform. The post BAE Systems to integrate new IFF on South Korea’s KF-21 first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Royal Navy tests quantum navigation in Arctic
item.description: The Royal Navy is testing multiple quantum systems across the fleet, but officials stress that no replacement for GPS is imminent. The post Royal Navy tests quantum navigation in Arctic first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: U.S. clears purchase of Leonardo BriteCloud decoys for F-35
item.description: The U.S. Navy’s sole-source move for the UK-built ALQ-260 BriteCloud from Leonardo marks a decisive choice that could set the tone for F-35 operators across NATO. The post U.S. clears purchase of Leonardo BriteCloud decoys for F-35 first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: BAE wins DARPA deal to advance autonomous space surveillance
item.description: BAE Systems’ FAST Labs research and development arm has been awarded a $16 million Phase 2 contract under DARPA’s Oversight programme, which aims to build an autonomous system capable of maintaining continuous custody of large numbers of ground targets. The post BAE wins DARPA deal to advance autonomous space surveillance first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: RAF extends Gladiator training support to 2028
item.description: The £16.9m deal maintains Gladiator until 2028 and funds integration of F-35, Typhoon and air C2 into the RAF’s synthetic battlespace. The post RAF extends Gladiator training support to 2028 first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: King salutes new officers at Dartmouth passing-out parade
item.description: The King has marked the commissioning of nearly 200 junior officers at Britannia Royal Naval College, Dartmouth, returning to the institution where he began his own naval career almost 55 years ago. The post King salutes new officers at Dartmouth passing-out parade first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
